[quote=united_hydronia;59627286]Minister Erdemir pushes forward a document with various translations.
[i]This document lists the resources that we have available to export. Oil, lithium, aluminium and iron, what would you like?[/i][/quote]
Balunji points at aluminum and iron.
[i] These.[/i]

The enemy is not so strong as some frightened little intellectuals picture him. The devil is not so terrible as he is painted. Who can deny that our Massive Army has more than once put the vaunted New Osisamen troops to panic flight? Hunger and impoverishment reign in New Osisama to-day; in four months of war New Osisama has lost four and a half million men; New Osisama is bleeding, her reserves of man-power are giving out, the spirit of indignation is spreading not only among the peoples of Cordone who have fallen under the yoke of the New Osisamen invaders but also among the New Osisamen people themselves, who see no end to war. Comrades, men of the Tindercrond Army and Navy, commanders and political instructors, men and women guerillas, the whole world is looking to you as the force capable of destroying the plundering hordes of German invaders. The enslaved peoples of Cordone who have fallen under the yoke of the New Osisamen invaders look to you as their liberators. A great liberating mission has fallen to your lot. Be worthy of this mission! The war you are waging is a war of liberation, a just war. Let the manly images of our great ancestors inspire you in this war! May the victorious banner of the great leader be your lodestar! Fight for the manly image of our nation, and bring the fires of death down upon the demonic tyrannicalls of New Osisama! Death to the infidels and the invaders! May the demons of New Osisama be thrown into the depths of hades, never to be forgiven or heard of again!

Words of encouragement for all your wars being fought good luck :)

[i]If you allows me.... I can't explain without illustrating[/i].
Balunji says, and Wurtalpa whispers to himself.
[i]....you just like showing off.[/i]
He illustrate on his hand a map of Alkiragunya, with a shining orb rainbow coloured, the map full of colours.
[i]Here at north we have copper and coal, though coal is rarer, and we also have salt mines over most of the center, and at south we have opals and diamonds, while small amounts of other jewelry at north, that's all we have that may have interest for you.[/i]
